proof_boundary: Meaning confidence is separate from compiler layout and STRICT status. UNKNOWN retains neutral names. Raw source/displacement/external token hits are candidates, not type proofs.

restructuring.policy: All type/field records are owned by types.json, including compatibility types declared inside a unit. Globals used by both units are owned by globals.json. Unit scopes reference their ids. Original ids, evidence, domains and port notes are retained; refined meanings have history. No source declaration or TU boundary is moved.
